title: Aerated Winey Jamaican Chickpeas Bowl
description: A unique, paleo-friendly dish featuring aerated kombu-cold-extract and a hint of Jamaican spices. This recipe may help alleviate hangover symptoms.

ingredients.name: Kombu
ingredients.amount: 2 inches piece of dried kombu seaweed
ingredients.notes: For kombu cold extract, see notes.

instructions: Combine chickpeas, ginger, garlic, allspice, thyme, and smoked paprika in a medium-sized bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together kombu cold extract, coconut oil, and red wine vinegar until well combined.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until the chickpeas are evenly coated.
Transfer the mixture to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and use a fork to aerate the chickpeas, breaking them apart slightly.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20-25 minutes or until the chickpeas are lightly browned and crispy.
Remove from oven and stir in honey.
Return to oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes or until caramelized.
Remove from oven, let cool, and serve hot.
Note: To make kombu cold extract, soak 2 inches piece of dried kombu seaweed in 1 cup of water for 4-8 hours. Strain and discard the seaweed, reserving the liquid for use in this recipe.
